limits.scope: JSON player-API fetch response clones only; not total browser/site buffering.

validation.deadlineQualification: The browser registered a 30000 ms timer. Fixture invokes that callback deterministically and checks cancellation, lock release, original promise/body and cleanup. No real-time 30-second expiry measurement.
validation.streamErrorQualification: Matches native-clone control in Edge; no assertion that synthetic source error messages survive native tee cloning unchanged.
limitations: Both bundle implementations run in headless Edge; actual Firefox engine and active personal-profile integration remain unqualified.
SABR/UMP response and streamed request-body readers require their own cancellation and budget qualification.
Source authority for fresh clones of stale player objects and legitimate in-place mutations remains open.
Live public pre-roll, desktop handoff, exact final-file verification, installed 7.27 acceptance, full suite and paired IDM timing remain outstanding.
